name: dsh-sketch-draft
description: DSH 永久插件：输入框「+」旁的草图按钮 —— 现画一张，直接作为图片附件注入对话；当前模型不收图时先实时查模型表、切到视觉模型再注入，并给一键切回。判定全程实时（会话投影的 pending 模型 + 宿主模型表的 inputModalities），可用不上 DET 独立运行。Permanent DeepSeek Harness plugin: an inline sketch button that draws on a canvas and injects the picture into the conversation as a real image attachment; when the current model takes no images it re-checks the live model table, switches to a vision model, injects, and offers one-click switch-back. Runs standalone, fully independent of DET.
author: L2959159224@Outlook.com
